explication: HTTPie is a human-friendly command-line HTTP client. The principal workflow is: a user invokes the CLI, arguments and request items are parsed, a request is assembled, HTTP(S) transport sends it to an API server, and the response is streamed through formatting to the terminal or a download file. Persistent sessions contribute headers, cookies, and authentication. The manager provides separate session-upgrade and plugin-management workflows. The graph emphasizes runtime paths supported by the tree, README, and sampled excerpts; some internal orchestration is inferred only where documented.
